title: Page 172
transc:
McCaine #19  Washn Sept 10th 1864 
Hannah Federal for Nabob zebra I've been obliged
to senda Battalion torch platina Andover pacific to 
Port Tobacco to break up Block head running
& to spur poplars from A P zodiac
Ive a Battalion of plug & perfume quincy
spit under Tappan Brown now on duty vomiting
the Upper Attica can I retain them sligo 
place of the Battalion torch platina Andover sugar
Tappan Ludlow paddle Andover returned here yesterday from
Laughters mill & vicinity whites no ridge about
except small bodies of Mosbys spit which its
impossible to get in to a ravish Gimlet
